# CartGenerator 0.5.4 macOS Hotfix
Release date: 2026-10-07 Platform: macOS arm64 Distribution: ad-hoc-signed direct-download DMG (not notarized)
## Artifact
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.4-macOS-arm64.dmg` - Size: 259 MB - SHA-256: `22ba8489639740b98683687c8cb4a123d709d7a4135e5043ac7e6693cfc92151`
## Workflow and UI fixes
- Step 2 table scroll is retained when thumbnail completion refreshes the UI. - Step 3 result-card filters remain selected while new item results arrive. - Hidden native compatibility buttons no longer detach into separate macOS windows. - CartGenerator reclaims foreground focus after launching or restarting Chromium. - Normal completion navigates Chromium to the verified cart page, matching the legacy workflow. - Internal `no_match` result text is displayed as `該当商品なし`, with other common statuses localized. - Rerunning from Step 2 now uses a combined confirmation for unexported result disposal and cart clearing. - After consent, a non-empty cart is cleared automatically and processing resumes; first-run cart waits still expose a visible `カートを空にして開始` action.
## Verification performed
- 235 Python tests and 6 Worker tests passed. - Python compilation and diff checks passed. - Real Chromium local-HTML QA verified Step 2 scroll `620 -> 620`, Step 3 filter persistence across updates, and the cart-clear action state. - The packaged app passed both direct-bundle and read-only mounted-DMG Cocoa startup/shutdown smoke checks with isolated Application Data. - No live cart mutation was performed for this hotfix.
## Installation
Use Help -> Check for Updates in CartGenerator 0.5.3, or install the DMG over the previous version.
## Source archive
- `releases/CartGenerator-0.5.4-source.tar.gz` - SHA-256: `6c9f4f4c05c4dbc83d8bf352bfb9a87598db6b0aca7b9dca3a27c836fe700500`
## Automatic updates
After publication, the signed Sparkle feed will offer 0.5.4 to 0.5.3.
